title: Current Kitab Ghar Main Home Page
purpose: Initial capture of the actual running Vite main application.
what_it_demonstrates: The official header, current Book Genie artwork, navigation and current home hero are rendered directly by the main client.

title: Current Main Home Content
purpose: Capture of the genuine main application's reader-service section.
what_it_demonstrates: The current main UI continues from the hero into the Badlapur service and collection experience, rather than a recreated experiment shell.

title: Current Book Genie Popup
purpose: Open Ask the Book Genie from the actual main home hero.
what_it_demonstrates: The self-managed Book Genie dialog opens from the current component's popup state.

title: Book Genie Question Options
purpose: Start a new Book Genie session.
what_it_demonstrates: The option array is mapped into interactive category buttons in the real wizard popup.

title: Book Genie Event-Driven Question Flow
purpose: Choose Mystery and suspense in question one.
what_it_demonstrates: An anonymous option event changes state and selects the mystery-specific next array of choices.

title: Live Book Genie Recommendations
purpose: Complete the mystery preference flow against the configured live catalogue.
what_it_demonstrates: The current recommendation engine scores the live books and returns three Book Genie recommendations.

title: Current API-Backed Books Page
purpose: Open the real main Books route.
what_it_demonstrates: The actual current page shows the 77-title API-backed catalogue and current filter interface.

title: Current Rendered Book Cards
purpose: Capture the rendered book-card output in the actual current Books page.
what_it_demonstrates: The current main client maps the API-backed book array into visible card components with title, author, category and availability data.
